messages:
Maya Kim: FYI sales flagged AcmeCorp - they want a dedicated pool for embeddings (customer P0). Key ask: predictable throughput, fast tail-latency, bursty ETL windows.
Patrick Lopez: Can you paste the numbers from the call?
Maya Kim: From call notes: ~1.2M embeddings/day, baseline ~200 rps, spikes up to ~2k rps for 5-15m, embedding dim 1536, SLA 95th latency <200ms, must be isolated (no shared noisy neighbors).
Sanjay Rao: Rough sizing thought: for 1536-d embeddings with q4/eff kernels, that baseline+spike profile maps to ~8 H100-80GB effective GPUs to hit tail SLOs if we rely on batching and KV cache. Need model size to refine.
Julie Chen: They specifically asked about autoscaling and burst credits - want instant bursts for ETL windows but not pay for peak 24/7. Any ideas on mix reserved+burst?
Maya Kim: Sales prefers reserved baseline + burstable capacity (spot/preemptible) for 10m windows. Legal insists on dedicated tenancy for training data isolation.
Patrick Lopez: Proposed config: reserved pool min=4 GPUs, target steady=12 GPUs (to meet 95th), autoscale min=4 max=20, cold-start warmup 60s. Burst policy: allow additional +8 GPUs via spot for up to 10 minutes per event. Also enable prefix/KV caching and batching.
Sanjay Rao: Implementation notes: set batching window ~20ms, batch_size target 64-128, continuous batching enabled. Use quantization strategy q4_0 for embeddings to reduce memory. If we see steady spikes, schedule cron-based scale-ups around ETL.
infra-bot: plan created: /plans/dedicated-acmecorp-1865407892 - owners: @Patrick Lopez, @Sanjay Rao
Julie Chen: Product acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) end-to-end load test with customer payloads shows sustained baseline and spike pass 95th <200ms 2) autoscale/burst exercised in staging with rollback validated 3) cost estimate for reserved+burst documented and approved 4) runbook for ops and customer support created
Maya Kim: I'll create the intake ticket with these ACs and attach call recording. @Patrick can you own the sizing calc and cost estimate by EOD tomorrow?
Patrick Lopez: Yep. I'll run sims against current perf profiles and post the GPU counts / token cost / expected monthly cost.
Sanjay Rao: One more: add a metric for burst failure rate and fallback behavior - if spot unavailable, route to compatible lower-cost model variant or throttle gracefully.
Maya Kim: Good call. I'll add fallback options to the ticket. Asking customer for representative payloads and ETL cadence. :thumbsup:
